plate_comment: Stage 2 of the valve position control loop: a PID controller on the error between the filtered position reference and variable_geometry_turbocharger_position; the proportional term (gain / 128 x error), the derivative term (filtered error change x gain >> 3, off below the noise band), the feedforward load offset and the integral term (accumulator >> 14) are summed and limited to +-32767 into variable_geometry_turbocharger_pid_duty (12800 = 100 percent). The integral accumulates the error x integral gain only after a pass in control state 0 and while the error is outside the steady-state band, and is reduced by the friction avoidance term while the motor current is at or above variable_geometry_turbocharger_steady_state_current_maximum. (was cm848_calculateActuatorEDriveCommand, before that cm848_calculateSpeedControlFiltered)

Every PID word (P / I / D gain and term, I term input and lower limit, FF term, prefilter constant, friction avoidance) has its e2m counterpart at the same offset in the 0x40b002 block.
